_comment: Default tool role of the FPGA flow (docs/spec/fpga-flow.md): Vivado, out-of-context synthesis. Used by this flow only, when no tools.json / tools.roles of the project defines `fpga_synth`; define your own `fpga_synth` role to change the module or the command.

fpga_synth.description: Vivado batch run of the Tcl script Q3TUI writes (read RTL + SDC, synth_design -mode out_of_context, reports)
